;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Syrian Civil War]]
**The [[Kurds|Kurdish]] [[People's Protection Units|YPG]] calls on Syrian government troops to protect [[Manbij]] against what it calls a "[[Turkish involvement in the Syrian Civil War|Turkish invasion]]". *An explosion caused by a roadside bomb hits a tourist bus in [[Cairo]], [[Egypt]], near the [[Giza pyramid complex]]. Three Vietnamese tourists and an Egyptian tour guide are killed, while 12 others are injured. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-46702301 (BBC)]

;Arts and culture
*After a 56-day trek, [[British Army]] captain Lou Rudd becomes the second person to cross [[Antarctica]] alone and unaided, over two decades after the first solo crossing by [[Norwegians|Norwegian]] [[Børge Ousland]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-england-hereford-worcester-46709412 (BBC)]

;International relations
*[[Foreign relations of Bahrain]]
**[[Bahrain]] announces it will reopen its embassy in [[Damascus]], [[Syria]], a day after the [[United Arab Emirates|UAE]] made the same decision. [https://www.rt.com/news/447603-bahrain-embassy-damascus-open/ (RT)]

;Law and crime
*[[2018 Leicester explosion]]
**The three men suspected of causing an explosion at a shop in [[Leicester]] in February are convicted of [[murder in English law|murder]]. The explosion destroyed the shop and the [[apartment|flat]] above it, killing five people. The three men were also convicted of conspiracy with one of the victims to commit [[insurance fraud]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/uk-news/2018/dec/28/three-men-convicted-of-in-leicester-shop-explosion (''The Guardian'')]
